title: Meet M2 Lab: start with the Friday update
hooks: Still rebuilding the same Friday update? That is a useful place to start with AI.
If AI feels too broad, put one weekly task on the table.
Here is the plain-English version of what M2 Lab does.
full_spoken_english: Still rebuilding the same Friday update? That is a useful place to start with AI. We're M2 Lab. We help small-business teams work out where AI fits, and what still needs a person. Imagine three project notes becoming one customer update. Start with the notes, the reader, and the decision they need to make. Then map the steps: collect facts, draft the update, check it, send it. Give each step an owner. AI could help with the draft. The person checking it needs the original notes, including anything that is missing. Try one fictional example first. Does an unknown delivery date stay unknown? Can you trace every sentence back to a note? Start with one repeated task. Write down its source notes, its reviewer, and the mistake that would matter. Which weekly task would you test?
cta: Start with one repeated task. Write down its source notes, its reviewer, and the mistake that would matter. Which weekly task would you test?

fixture.input: Project A: artwork approved. Project B: delivery date unconfirmed. Reader: customer.
fixture.designed_output: Artwork approved. We are confirming the delivery date.
fixture.check: No invented date; each sentence maps to a supplied fact.

audio_plan: Natural recorded voice; no imitation. Quiet room; optional subtle licensed music only after voice intelligibility check. No sound needed to understand proof panels.
caption_plan: Editable sentence captions, maximum two short lines; keep proof labels clear. Captions paraphrase nothing that changes a fact. Final platform safe-zone check after edit.
